name: dsh-better-debug
description: 当Coding Agent遇到方法论失效、reasoning僵化、被难题卡住或持续打转时的over-commitment/blind commitment/Einstellung effect检测与修正：用事件流里的行为证据（盲改 / 重复报错 / 错误族 / 验证振荡 / 补丁链 / 干预失效）判断是否陷入无效迭代与更改，并在下一步前注入一条观察与转向建议，使模型自觉进行intention reconsideration（意图重考虑）。不调 LLM、不改 agent loop、不解析模型输出。
author: Leonlee114514

scripts.check: node --check scripts/pack-check.mjs && node --check scripts/lint.mjs && node --check scripts/judge-health.mjs && node --check lib/index.js && node --check lib/panel.js && node --check lib/text.js && node --check client.js && node --check test/sim.mjs && node --check test/panel.mjs && node --check test/posix/register.mjs && node --check test/posix/hooks.mjs && node --check test/posix/path.mjs && node --check test/linux/register.mjs && node --check test/slow/register.mjs && node --check test/slow/fs.mjs && node --check test/client.mjs
scripts.test:unit: node test/sim.mjs && node test/panel.mjs && node test/client.mjs && node scripts/judge-health.mjs test/fixtures/better-debug.sample.log
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:posix && npm run test:linux && npm run test:slow
scripts.verify: npm run check && npm run lint && npm run pack-check && npm test
